title: StrategyResult
description: strategy.result r1: one evaluated result of one strategy in one run, with its legs, checks and facts; insert only, a rerun is a new run_id.

session_day.description: Run day: the session day the rows were computed for.

run_id.description: Run id of the runner; a rerun is a new run_id and rows are insert-only.

strategy.description: Id of the strategy that computed the row, for example short_put.

rule_version.description: Version of the strategy rule that computed the row.

param_hash.description: Hash of the parameters the strategy ran with.

key.description: Key of the result, unique within a day and strategy.

status.description: Row status: blocked if any check blocked, else unknown if any check is unknown, else ok.

rank.description: Position of an ok row in the run; null when not ranked.

rank_in_underlying.description: Position of an ok row within its underlying; null when not ranked.

legs.description: JSON array text of the legs of the result.

checks.description: Ordered JSON array text of the check results.

facts.description: JSON object text of the figures of the result; an absent figure is omitted.

computed_at.description: Instant the run computed the row, UTC; the newest run of a day is the one with the latest computed_at.

settings_version.description: Version of the owner settings the run used; null when the row was computed without owner settings.
